title: 1961-2025 locked hydrology forcing acquisition and extension registry
objective: Extend the accepted state-consistent Reach and reservoir hydrology interface to 1961-2025 without refitting model parameters.

authoritative_pet.1961_2024: CMFD V2.0 temp/pres/shum/wind/srad/lrad, preserving the accepted FAO-56 calculation
authoritative_pet.2025: ERA5-Land hourly meteorology harmonized to CMFD on a locked overlap period

allowed: download and integrity validation of frozen meteorological forcing
source harmonization using development-only overlap years
forcing-driven model execution with frozen parameters
forbidden: discharge observations in source or model selection
embedding API credentials in repository files or logs
successor_rule: Use the next free 20260828_* folder; every repair or new experiment requires its own contract before result access.
